description: The exact <script> tag that installs krawlup first-party analytics on a product's own website (visitors, sessions, pages, referrers, countries, conversion goals). The returned snippet already embeds the site token at data-site="…" — insert BOTH lines yourself; never ask the founder to paste the token. After installing, confirm data appears in the dashboard Website tab within a minute of the first visit
name: get_analytics_snippet
